source: Original deterministic RGB pattern; generate_raw.c, CC0-1.0. Not downloaded media.
encoder_version: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

generation.common: ffmpeg -y -v error -f rawvideo -pixel_format rgb24 -video_size 48x32 -framerate 25 -i pattern.rgb -an -c:v mpeg1video -g 9 -q:v 4 -sc_threshold 1000000000 -f mpeg1video
generation.open.m1v: common + -bf 2; append 00 00 01 b7 and 256 zero bytes
generation.ip.m1v: common + -bf 0; append 00 00 01 b7 and 256 zero bytes

runtime: No encoder required. Fixed files are decoded by included upstream C source. Tests must not invoke encoder.
